parameters.query:
SELECT lot_key, cadastral_number, nspd_address AS address,
 center_latitude AS latitude, center_longitude AS longitude,
 source_url, last_seen_at
FROM landlots.lots
WHERE region_code = '50'
 AND (JSON_CONTAINS($1, JSON_QUOTE(lot_key))
      OR JSON_CONTAINS($1, JSON_QUOTE(cadastral_number)))
ORDER BY lot_key
LIMIT 1001;
